description: This is a Java Spring MVC controller class named SecurityController. It handles admin security-related web requests such as displaying user permissions and groups, and sets up the menu for the admin UI.

classes.name: SecurityController
classes.description: Spring MVC controller for handling security management pages in the admin interface.

methods.name: displayPermissions
methods.description: Handles GET requests to display the permissions page for admin users.

methods.name: displayGroups
methods.description: Handles GET requests to display user groups for admin users.

methods.name: setMenu
methods.description: Sets the menu context for admin pages, determining which menu items are active and which menu is currently selected.
